card.title: Nintendo 3DS blue light turns on then turns off

source.title: Nintendo 3DS blue light turns on then turns off

symptoms: blue light turns on then off

claims.statement: On 3DS, if the power LED fades out slowly after fading in it's almost always software (e.g. softmod SD card missing files); if it cuts out instantly, often with a pop, it's hardware.
If hinge position changes the behaviour, the top screen flex is damaged.

Hardware shutdown causes include open or shorted backlights, shorted display high-voltage rails (+10 V / -15 V), both screens' HV open (bad flex/connector), shorted camera flex data lines, or an open speaker/codec connection.
Softmodded units need a FAT32 SD with boot.firm (b9s/fastboot3DS) or arm9loaderhax.bin.

procedure: Watch whether the LED fades or cuts out.
Software: check SD format and boot files.
Hardware: check display, backlight, camera flexes and connectors, speakers and liquid damage.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
